### Combined treatment and follow-up by G6PD status

| G6PD category | Radical-cure treatment policy | Treatment implementation | Treatment implementation details | Treatment implementation year | Follow-up approach | Follow-up implementation | Follow-up implementation year |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **G6PD normal: ≥ 6.1 Ul/gHb** | TQ 300 mg or 100mg, 200 mg | Implemented | No primaquine or tafenoquine without G6PD testing | 2024 | No follow-up | _Not reported_ | _Not reported_ |
| **G6PD intermediate: 4.1-6.0 Ul/gHb** | PQ 0.5 mg/kg/day over 7 days | Implemented | No primaquine or tafenoquine without G6PD testing | 2024 | No follow-up | _Not reported_ | _Not reported_ |
| **G6PD deficient: ≤ 4.0 Ul/gHb** | PQ 0.75 mg/kg/week weekly for 8 weeks | Implemented | No primaquine or tafenoquine without G6PD testing | 2024 | DOT where possible | Partially implemented | 2024 |
| **If no testing available** | No PQ or TQ | Implemented | No primaquine or tafenoquine without G6PD testing | 2024 | _Not reported_ | _Not reported_ | _Not reported_ |
:::

Reported dosing structures and treatment recommendations for specific populations.

<div class="country-note-groups country-note-groups--case-management">
<details class="country-note-group">

<div class="country-note-group__body">
<div class="country-note-item">
<h4>Adult primaquine dosage bG6PD normal: ≥ 6.1 Ul/gHb</h4>
<p>Fixed dose</p>
</div>
<div class="country-note-item">
<h4>Adult primaquine dosage — G6PD intermediate: 4.1-6.0 Ul/gHb</h4>
<p>0.4 - 1 vs 0.5</p>
</div>
<div class="country-note-item">
<h4>Adult primaquine dosage bG6PD deficient: ≤ 4.0 Ul/gHb</h4>
<p>0.6 - 1.3 vs 0.75</p>
</div>
<div class="country-note-item">
<h4>Primaquine weight-based banding bG6PD normal: ≥ 6.1 Ul/gHb</h4>
<p>Fixed dose</p>
</div>
<div class="country-note-item">
<h4>Primaquine weight-based banding — G6PD intermediate: 4.1-6.0 Ul/gHb</h4>
<p>3 adult weight bands: 50-69 kgs, 70-89 kgs, 90-120 kgs</p>
</div>
<div class="country-note-item">
<h4>Primaquine weight-based banding bG6PD deficient: ≤ 4.0 Ul/gHb</h4>
<p>3 adult weight bands: 50-69kgs, 70-89kgs, 90-120kgs</p>
</div>
<div class="country-note-item">
<h4>Schizontocidal weight-based banding bG6PD normal: ≥ 6.1 Ul/gHb</h4>
<p>1 adult weight band: ≥ 50 kgs</p>
</div>
<div class="country-note-item">
<h4>Schizontocidal weight-based banding bG6PD intermediate: 4.1-6.0 Ul/gHb, G6PD deficient: ≤ 4.0 Ul/gHb</h4>
<p>3 adult weight bands: 50-69 kgs, 70-89 kgs, 90-120 kgs</p>
</div>
</div>
</details>

<div class="country-note-groups country-note-groups--case-management">
<details class="country-note-group">
<summary>
<span>Country-specific policy context</span>
<small>1 note</small>
</summary>
<div class="country-note-group__body">
<div class="country-note-item">
<h4>Policy note</h4>
<p>Brazil has approved the use of TQ in adults in 2023 with quant G6PD testing being rolled out being completed between June 2024 and April 2025 in 49 municipalities in six states and nine Special Indigenous Health Districts. In June 2025, Brazil adopted a child formulation of TQ.</p>
</div>
</div>
</details>
</div>

<div class="country-note-groups country-note-groups--case-management">

<div class="country-note-group__body">
<div class="country-note-item">
<h4>Policy note</h4>
<p>TQ not included in 2021 Policy, but Brazil has approved the use of TQ in adults in 2023 with quant G6PD testing being rolled out being completed between June 2024 and April 2025 in 49 municipalities in six states and nine Special Indigenous Health Districts. In June 2025, Brazil adopted a child formulation of TQ</p>
</div>
</div>
</details>
</div>
